title: I made a tiny world-in-your-browser 🌎 where creatures eat words, throw raves and dream about their day. Done with a team of Claude agents in 4 days 🤖
author: jeffyclassify
selftext:
Id|le is a little world whose ground is made of words. The creatures walk on them, eat them, make friends, gossip, build huts, plot charts (and others break the charts into code and eat it), hide from storms, and dance when you turn the rave on. You can read their minds, and when they sleep you can watch them dream. The world even cuts its own films out of their memories

I built it in 4 days with a team of Claude agents: one manager session I talk to, and a fork for each feature, working in parallel. Every feature ships with tests, a devlog entry and a page in the game's own encyclopedia. 33+ agent tasks, all in the open on GitHub

Some favorite bits: a data lab where each creature is a real text classifier running in your browser, a DJ deck, Wikipedia worlds (grow a world from any article: id-le.com/?wiki=Octopus), and a Tiny Operator, a 10.8 MB chat model we trained from scratch that you can talk to and that changes the world for you



Free, open source, no install: [Id|le: Happy Halloween 🎃](https://id-le.com/?halloween&utm_source=r-aigamedev)



Code: [https://github.com/nicobrenner/id-le](https://github.com/nicobrenner/id-le)



👉 What would you want the creatures to do next?

comments.author: jeffyclassify
